meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将Markdown快速转为微信公众号文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将Markdown稿件发布到微信公众号
copy.tagline_en: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account articles quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often publish Markdown drafts to WeChat Official Account

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你把 Markdown 文章转为微信公众号 HTML，生成文章图片、创建草稿、按创作者风格写作、给出标题建议、消除 AI 痕迹，还能检查支持的主题、提供商和提示。
howto.when: 当你提到“Markdown 转微信”、“公众号文章”等关键词，或要求对 Markdown 文章进行格式化、生成图片、创建草稿时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇 Markdown 文章转换为微信公众号 HTML。
say.note: Claude 会使用默认配置转换并返回 HTML。

say.text: 请为这篇文章建议几个标题。
say.note: Claude 会运行标题建议命令，返回候选标题。

say.text: 消除这篇文章的 AI 写作痕迹。
say.note: Claude 会执行 humanize 命令，改写文章。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, generate article images, create drafts, write in creator styles, suggest titles, remove AI writing traces, and inspect supported providers, themes, and prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'Markdown to WeChat,' 'WeChat Official Account article,' or request conversion, formatting, image generation, or draft creation for Markdown articles.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown article to WeChat Official Account HTML.
say_en.note: Claude will convert using default settings and return the HTML.

say_en.text: Suggest some titles for this article.
say_en.note: Claude will run title suggestion and return candidates.

say_en.text: Remove AI writing traces from this article.
say_en.note: Claude will run the humanize command to rewrite the article.
